verdict.rationale: MX documents a dedicated test platform with four test institutions and an OpenAPI spec/Postman collection for exercising the API outside production, plus guidance on testing the Connect Widget/OAuth flows — a clear sandbox testing path. However, evidence doesn't explicitly frame this as an 'AI-native' or agentic testing workflow, nor confirm isolation guarantees (e.g., no real data ever touched) beyond the test institutions being separate from production. missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-oriented sandbox usage, independent/hands-on confirmation of full production-data isolation.
